comparisons.comparison_scope: bracketing controls in one allocation
comparisons.note: Basic NPU PASS; O51862 vs E10450555/50680, observed +2.46%. Single screen with overlapping samples; no qualifying gain, no adoption/official submission. Full-v1 compiler failure repaired without declaring Sub unsupported.

comparisons.comparison_scope: bracketing controls in one allocation
comparisons.note: Whole O compile/basic NPU PASS; O55608 vs E10451007/51274, +8.74%. One allocation, two transport alternatives in one M01 family; no adoption/official submission.

comparisons.comparison_scope: bracketing controls in one allocation

comparisons.method: M02: K-half clusters, global H interleave, full-H padded gather/compact and F32 cluster sum
comparisons.comparison_scope: bracketing controls in one allocation
comparisons.note: Whole O compile/basic NPU PASS; O78981 vs E10451010/50901, +55.00%. One allocation, two complete mappings of one M02 family. v4 static ordering reverses on NPU. No adoption/official submission.
